subject: Discovery recap: trial scope, success metrics, and exec readout request
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: trial scope, success metrics, and exec readout request

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the trial plan.

TL;DR:
- Proposed trial window: 4 weeks (start target Aug 16)
- Success criteria (draft) attached — please confirm or flag changes
- Owners: NovaMed product (Tom), NovaMed IT/security (Elena), Redwood SE (Marissa), Redwood AM (me)
- Exec readout: request a 30–45m slot the week of Aug 30 for go/no-go decision

Recap (short): you want to validate Redwood inference for clinical note summarization at ~500 concurrent users, with latency target <300ms p50 and acceptable model fidelity on a labeled prompt set. You also highlighted data residency and audit logs as procurement blockers.

Draft success criteria (attached redwood_poc_template.xlsx):
- Throughput: sustained 1200 requests/minute with 95th percentile latency <600ms
- Latency target: p50 <300ms for 512-token prompts (core clinician flows)
- Quality: >= 85% accuracy on curated evaluation set (we'll share scoring rubric)
- Security: SOC2 evidence and encryption-in-transit + at-rest checklist completed
- Cost: projected 30-day run cost estimate within the committed budget range (we'll provide expected burn numbers)

Questions / asks for NovaMed:
1) Confirm the evaluation prompt set owner (who will sign-off on the labeled set?)
2) Confirm a primary procurement contact (procurement@novamed.com?) and legal timeline
3) Any constraints on IP or retention we should know for the trial environment

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm success criteria (reply inline) by EOD Thu Aug 5
- Redwood shares finalized trial runbook + temp credentials by Mon Aug 9
- Trial kick on Aug 16 — ops cadence weekly standups (time TBD)
- Exec readout slot the week of Aug 30 for decision and contract conversation

Attaching the POC template for quick edits: redwood_poc_template.xlsx (attachment).

If that all looks good, I’ll loop in Marissa to build the mutual action plan and schedule the exec slot.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
https://redwood.ai
(attachment: redwood_poc_template.xlsx)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novamed.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Howard <tom.howard@novamed.com>, procurement@novamed.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: trial scope, success metrics, and exec readout request

Diego — thank you for the clear summary. High level: we like the approach and timing. A few notes inline and one ask.

Inline:
- Throughput: the 1200 req/minute target is fine for the pilot but can we run a burst test to 2x during week 2? We want to see autoscaling behavior.
- Latency: p50 <300ms is acceptable; please capture p95 and p99 in the runbook as well.
- Quality: we’ll provide a 500-record labeled set; scoring rubric will be owned by Tom.
- Security: our security team attached a short questionnaire; see NovaMed-Security-Questions.pdf (attached). Please confirm who at Redwood will own the security responses.

Ask: we need a short (1 page) summary of the trial environment and data handling for procurement and legal — can you provide that by Friday Aug 6?

Also looping Tom (product) and procurement for timeline visibility.

Best,
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Clinical Informatics | NovaMed
elena.ruiz@novamed.com
(attachment: NovaMed-Security-Questions.pdf)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Tom Howard <tom.howard@novamed.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2027 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Finalized trial plan + owner map (for Aug 16 start)

Elena / Tom — thanks for the quick confirmation. Per your asks, I’m attaching a slightly updated plan and the owner map. Highlights below; full runbook attached as poc-success-metrics.md and mutual-action-plan.docx.

Key changes made:
- Added burst test to Week 2 (2x target for 10 minutes to validate autoscaling)
- Added p95/p99 latency collection and dashboards for the runbook
- Security questionnaire assigned to Marissa (SE) to lead responses with security@redwood.ai as the escalation
- Pre-read for procurement: one-page environment & data handling summary attached in the runbook

Ownership / milestones:
- NovaMed:
  - Tom Howard — evaluation set owner & quality sign-off
  - Elena Ruiz — security & procurement liaison
  - procurement@novamed.com — contract timeline lead
- Redwood:
  - Marissa Cole — trial ops lead (SE), completes security questionnaire and runbook config
  - Diego Fernandez — commercial owner, coordinates exec readout and contract path
  - Grace Oconnor — solutions architect for integration and model profiling

Milestone schedule (high level):
- Aug 6: procurement pre-read delivered (Redwood) — you asked for EOD Aug 6
- Aug 9: trial credentials and runbook available to NovaMed
- Aug 16: trial run begins
- Aug 23: mid-trial burst/autoscale test (week 2)
- Aug 30: exec readout (30–45m) for go/no-go and commercial terms

Measurement plan (how we’ll judge success):
- Operational: p50/p95/p99 latency, requests/min sustained, error rate <0.5%
- Quality: automated scoring against Tom’s 500 sample labeled set (>=85% pass threshold)
- Security: questionnaire complete, SOC2 evidence shared, retention policy confirmed

Attachments: poc-success-metrics.md, mutual-action-plan.docx (see attachments).

If all good, Marissa will send calendar options for the exec readout and a short procurement pre-read by EOD Aug 6.

Thanks — I’ll wait for Tom on the evaluation-set sign-off and for procurement to confirm timelines.

Diego
(attachment: poc-success-metrics.md)
(attachment: mutual-action-plan.docx)
